q: How much is the first cup?

context.title: 买杯子
lines: A：这个杯子多少钱？  (How much is this cup?)
B：十八块。  (Eighteen yuan.)
A：那个呢？  (And that one?)
B：那个二十五块。  (That one is twenty-five yuan.)
A：我要这个。  (I'll take this one.)
B：好的，十八块。  (OK, eighteen yuan.)

why: A asks the price of 这个杯子, and B answers 十八块, so the first cup costs 18 yuan.

not.25 yuan: 二十五块 is the price of 那个, the other cup.
not.8 yuan: 十八 is ten plus eight, not just 八.
not.80 yuan: 八十 is 80; B says 十八, which is 18.

not.Neither: A says 我要这个, so A does buy a cup.

A：你的书比我多一本。  (You have one more book than me.)

why: B says 我七岁了, so B is seven.

not.Eight: 八岁 is A's age, not B's.
not.Nine: A has 九本书; nine is not an age here.
not.Ten: B has 十本书; ten is the books, not the age.
